Part 3\n\nScene: Angel Grove Youth Center\n\nIt’s been a few weeks since their date and subsequent monster battle, and Zack and Launch have been spending a lot of time together. They’ve gone on several more dates and have even spent time training together to improve their fighting skills.\n\nZack: (smiling) You’re getting really good at this, Launch. You know, I’ve been meaning to tell you something.\n\nLaunch: (curious) What is it?\n\nZack: (serious) I’ve been thinking about my future as a Power Ranger. And… I’m not sure if I want to keep doing this forever.\n\nLaunch: (surprised) Really? But you love being a Power Ranger.\n\nZack: I do. But I also want to explore other things and maybe even start a family someday. And being a Power Ranger, that’s always going to be risky and unpredictable.\n\nLaunch: (nodding) I see. But I also don’t want to hold you back from anything you might want in the future.\n\nLaunch: (smiling reassuringly) Zack, you’re not going to lose me. And you’re not holding me back from anything. I like you for who you are, not just as a Power Ranger. Whether you’re a Power Ranger or not, I’m with you because I want to be with you.\n\nZack: (relieved) Thank you, Launch. Something important.\n\nZack: (concerned) What is it, Launch?\n\nLaunch takes a deep breath before speaking, “I have a daughter.”\n\nZack’s eyes widen in surprise, but he quickly recovers and takes her hand, “That’s amazing, Launch. I want to meet her.”\n\nLaunch’s eyes light up, “You mean it?”\n\nZack nods, “Of course. Anything that’s important to you is important to me.”\n\nLaunch leans in to kiss him, and as they pull away, they both know that they’re in this for the long haul.
